title: Tariffs: calculations and the date importer's choice
subject: Business
unit: Spring 1: The international economy and government (1.5, 1.6)
source: Written for business/y10 lesson 31 (Pupil PDF worksheet: tariff calculations and supplier case)
intro: Lesson 31. Tariff: a tax on imports. New cost = price × (1 + tariff rate).

questions.q: A 10% tariff is added to imported tyres costing £80 each. Calculate the new cost of 50 tyres.
A 15% tariff is added to bicycles costing £200 each. What is the new cost of one bicycle?
A 5% tariff is added to rice costing £1.20 per kg. What is the cost of 500 kg?
A 20% tariff is added to steel costing £600 a tonne. How much more do 30 tonnes cost because of the tariff?

passage.title: Medina Dates Ltd
paras: Medina Dates Ltd imports dates into the UK and sells them to shops, especially before Ramadan. It needs 20,000 kg for the next season.
Supplier A is in a country with no trade agreement with the UK, so an 8% tariff is added. Supplier B is in a country with a free-trade agreement, so there is no tariff, but its price is higher.
passage.source: All businesses, people and figures in this case are fictional, made up for practice.

head: Supplier A
Supplier B
rows: Price per kg before any tariff

questions.q: Calculate the cost per kg from Supplier A including the tariff.
Calculate the total cost of 20,000 kg from each supplier.

blocks.text: Justify which supplier Medina Dates Ltd should use. (6 marks)

frame.label: Because (use the data)
frame.prompt: Give a reason and develop it into a chain, using figures from the case.

frame.label: However (the other option)
frame.prompt: Give the strongest point for the other option and develop it.

frame.label: Overall, why my choice beats it
frame.prompt: Compare the two: why your option is better for THIS business.

markScheme.a: Supplier B: cheaper once the tariff is added (£5.30 against £5.40 a kg, £2,000 less for 20,000 kg), faster delivery before Ramadan, fewer damaged boxes. Supplier A only if justified (e.g. if the tariff were removed). Best answers use the figures and compare.
